setup.command: mise install && flutter pub get && (command -v java >/dev/null || sh -c 'apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && apt-get install -y -qq default-jre-headless') && (command -v firebase >/dev/null || npm install -g --silent firebase-tools) && (test -x /home/hoplite/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb || sh -c 'mkdir -p /home/hoplite/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && curl -sSLo /tmp/tools.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip && unzip -q /tmp/tools.zip -d /home/hoplite/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && (mv /home/hoplite/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools /home/hoplite/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest 2>/dev/null || true) && yes | /home/hoplite/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses >/dev/null && /home/hoplite/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager platform-tools "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" >/dev/null') && (command -v javac >/dev/null || apt-get install -y -qq openjdk-21-jdk-headless) && (flutter config --android-sdk /home/hoplite/android-sdk || true)

check.command: flutter analyze && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed . && flutter test
